crossRefs.note: Yahweh is good to all. His tender mercies are over all his works.
The young lions roar after their prey, and seek their food from God.
These all wait for you, that you may give them their food in due season.
who gives food to every creature; for his loving kindness endures forever.
who covers the sky with clouds, who prepares rain for the earth, who makes grass grow on the mountains.
He provides food for the livestock, and for the young ravens when they call.
To every animal of the earth, and to every bird of the sky, and to everything that creeps on the earth, in which there…
“Can you hunt the prey for the lioness, or satisfy the appetite of the young lions,
Don’t be afraid, you animals of the field; for the pastures of the wilderness spring up, for the tree bears its fruit.…
See the birds of the sky, that they don’t sow, neither do they reap, nor gather into barns. Your heavenly Father feeds…
Consider the ravens: they don’t sow, they don’t reap, they have no warehouse or barn, and God feeds them. How much more…
He isn’t served by men’s hands, as though he needed anything, seeing he himself gives to all life and breath, and all…

translations.web: The eyes of all wait for you. You give them their food in due season.
translations.bsb: The eyes of all look to You, and You give them their food in season.
translations.kjv: The eyes of all wait upon thee; and thou givest them their meat in due season.
translations.asv: The eyes of all wait for thee; And thou givest them their food in due season.
